description.zh:
返回值中是否包含没有版本状态的凭据版本。

取值范围：
- false（默认值）：不包含
- true：包含
description.en:
Specifies whether to include credential versions that have no version stages in the response.

Valid values:

- false (default): No

- true: Yes

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值：1。
description.en: The number of the page to return for a paged query. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置每页大小。默认值：20。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Default value: 20.

description.zh:
凭据名称或凭据资源名称（ARN）。
>访问其他阿里云账号下的凭据时，必须输入凭据ARN。凭据ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:secret/${secret-name}`。
description.en:
The name or Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the credential.

> When you access a credential that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must specify the ARN of the credential. The ARN of a credential is in the format of `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:secret/${secret-name}`.

title.zh: 查询凭据的所有版本信息

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

- 版本信息中不包含凭据值。默认只返回有版本状态的凭据版本。
descriptions.en:
- For more information about the access policy required for a RAM user or RAM role to call this OpenAPI, see [Resource Access Management](~~2767210~~).

- The version information does not include the secret value. By default, this operation returns only the secret versions that are marked with a version stage.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms list-secret-version-ids --secret-name secret001 --include-deprecated false --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms ListSecretVersionIds --region cn-hangzhou --SecretName secret001 --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --IncludeDeprecated false
